name: Zipporah
title: Moses' Midianite wife
summary: Zipporah was the daughter of Jethro, the priest of Midian, and became Moses' wife when he fled from Egypt. She is known for the dramatic event where she circumcised her son to save Moses from the Lord's anger, thus showing determination and decisiveness in a critical situation.

keyEvents.title: The Meeting at the Well
keyEvents.description: Moses met Zipporah and her sisters at a well in Midian after he fled from Egypt. He protected them from some shepherds and was invited to their father Jethro's home.

keyEvents.title: Marriage with Moses
keyEvents.description: Jethro gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses as a wife, and she bore him the son Gershom.

keyEvents.title: Circumcision of the Son
keyEvents.description: On the way back to Egypt, Zipporah took decisive action when the Lord sought to kill Moses. She circumcised her son with a flint stone and thus saved Moses' life.

keyEvents.title: Reunion with Moses
keyEvents.description: After leaving Egypt, Jethro brought Zipporah and her two sons back to Moses in the wilderness, where they were reunited.
